name: ryu.subtitles
description: Pick a video on this machine, transcribe it locally, translate the transcript into the language you want, and get a timed .srt or .vtt written beside the file so your player picks it up. Both model hops stay on the device — local whisper for the transcription, the local gateway's on-device model for the translation — so nothing about the video leaves the disk it is already on. Long jobs are queued and polled, so a feature film keeps working while you do something else.
